deviations_from_adr: Scope widened beyond the two named columns (subject «КОМУ» + granter «КТО-ВЫДАЛ»): the LIVE_PROOF render with the exact capstone employee-UUIDs exposed the SAME leak class in two adjacent spots on the same row — the «Роль · грант» column (roleLabelOf's subject-fallback surfaced a raw subject-UUID) and the «КТО-ПОДТВЕРДИЛ» provenance column (confirmed_by). Both are now closed under the same T-0648 resolver + machine-key-demotion path (server: confirmed_by added to the existing batchResolveActors call, no extra query; web: honest generic fallback). Not fixing them would have left the row still leaking a raw UUID first-class — the exact defect the task closes.
friction_events: Root cause was NOT 'resolver not applied to subject/granter' — the T-0648 server resolver already resolved actor+subject (batchResolveActors matches slug OR employee-UUID via id::text = ANY). The real leak was the WEB honest-fallback: when the resolver MISSES (a stale/cross-tenant employee UUID, or a subject that is a grant/assignment TARGET uuid, not an employee), coerceActorField returns {name:<uuid>, id:<uuid>} and ActorChip's displayName = name || id || label rendered the raw UUID as PRIMARY text. Fixed at the ActorChip primitive (right depth): a UUID/agent:/instance:/flw: machine-key name is never primary — demoted to tooltip+mono, honest generic type label shown instead. This also fixes the same leak on screen-audit / screen-inbox / screen-process-instance / operational-analytics (all pass name={display?.name || rawId}).

Live DB snapshot in this worktree differs from the capstone's: only ONE real grant-trail row exists (actor=e-owner slug resolves fine; subject=f5d1417b-… is a grant/assignment TARGET uuid that resolves to NO employee — the honest-fallback case). The defect-named UUIDs (e0000000-…/3462410f-…) were not present live, so LIVE_PROOF was done via a unit render feeding the exact capstone UUID shapes with resolver-miss (actorResolved/subjectResolved/confirmedResolved all undefined) — visible primary text: 'выдан Сервис Сервис — role-x role-x org:fin заведено человеком подтверждено', zero UUIDs.
